evidence.note: Clean serif title with sub-line and soft green blobs; consistent header bar and nav carried through every slide.
Three evenly spaced summary cards sit low under a large empty band below the title; tidy but a generic card row.
Measures slide is three plain text definitions in columns with no visual; sparse and generic.
Paired bar chart with target line builds well; insight overlay dims the chart cleanly without collisions.
Clean ruled table, consistent type; plain rather than designed.
Numbered phase list with a quote tile beside it; small text in the left third, much of the slide empty; reads as a list rather than a timeline diagram.
Two-cause node diagram with DISPUTED label and caption; purposeful and uncluttered, though small within the frame.
Three numbered questions in the left half; right half empty; consistent styling.

rationale: Styling is consistent and nothing collides across all slides and steps, and the s-4 chart and s-7 cause diagram are purposeful. But several slides (s-3 measures, s-6 roadworks, s-8 close, s-2 summary) are sparse text lists or card rows with small content in large empty space, so the deck reads clean but generic rather than at the reference's considered bar. That fits level 3 better than level 4.
